title: Replies finish when you leave · 0.6.1
description: Leave Lumen while it's writing and the reply keeps going; a notification tells you when it's ready.
notes: Switch apps or lock your iPhone while a reply is being written: it keeps going for as long as iOS allows (usually under a minute) instead of stopping.
When it's done, a notification shows the start of the reply. Tap it to open that chat. Temporary chats don't show their words on the lock screen.
Lumen asks once, the first time you send, whether it may notify you. Turn it off any time in Settings › Notifications.
Also in 0.6.0: voice input, Read aloud, and Siri and Shortcuts (Ask Lumen, Talk to Lumen, New Lumen chat).
